summary: Presidio Property Trust filed an 8-K reporting the expiration and results of its previously announced exchange offer, under which holders could exchange any and all outstanding 9.375% Series D Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock for newly issued Series A Common Stock. The offer expired at 11:59 p.m. New York City time on October 2, 2026, with 149,773 Series D preferred shares, about 15.4% of the class, validly tendered and accepted. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The exchange ratio was fixed at 5.5 common shares per preferred share, a liability-management move that reduces preferred liquidation and dividend obligations but increases common-share overhang and shifts capital structure risk to common holders.
